name: Azeroth Companion
title: Sovereign Intelligence — Connected Paths & Talent Navigation
features: New optional Path Navigator lets players find Blizzard talents by name or node ID and center them directly in the tree.
Connected path exploration highlights reported upstream and downstream talent relationships without implying official unlock eligibility.
Read-only talent briefing shows Blizzard-returned descriptions, official source IDs and allocated ranks.
New FIT TREE and CLEAR FOCUS actions simplify navigation, while preserving existing Ascendant View, rank controls and minimap.
All original saved builds, allocations, undo/redo, phone/PC controls, character connections, and media features remain unchanged.
